Bacterialblight.name: Bacterial Blight
Bacterialblight.description: A deadly bacterial disease caused by Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae.
Bacterialblight.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on leaf edges that turn yellow and eventually white. Milky bacterial ooze (droplets) may appear on young lesions in the morning.
Bacterialblight.cause: Bacterial pathogen Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae.
Bacterialblight.treatment: Drain the field. Apply copper-based fungicides if available. Use balanced fertilization (avoid excess Nitrogen).
Bacterialblight.prevention: Use resistant varieties. Keep fields clean of weeds. Ensure proper spacing between plants.

Blast.name: Rice Blast
Blast.description: A fungal disease caused by Magnaporthe oryzae, affecting all parts of the rice plant.
Blast.symptoms: Spindle-shaped spots with gray or white centers and brownish borders on leaves. Can also cause neck rot (neck blast).
Blast.treatment: Spray systemic fungicides like Tricyclazole or Isoprothiolane. Flood the field immediately after identifying symptoms.
Blast.prevention: Avoid late planting. Treat seeds before sowing. Burn infected straw and stubble.

Brownspot.name: Brown Spot
Brownspot.description: A fungal disease that often indicates poor soil fertility.
Brownspot.symptoms: Oval or circular brown spots with a gray or whitish center and reddish-brown margin.
Brownspot.treatment: Apply fungicides like Mancozeb or Propiconazole. Correct soil nutrient deficiencies, especially Potassium and Silicon.
Brownspot.prevention: Use certified disease-free seeds. Improve soil health with organic manure. Practice crop rotation.

Tungro.name: Rice Tungro Disease
Tungro.description: A viral disease transmitted by green leafhoppers.
Tungro.symptoms: Plants are stunted and leaf color changes from yellow to orange. Panicle emergence is delayed or incomplete.
Tungro.cause: Rice Tungro Bacilliform Virus (RTBV) and Rice Tungro Spherical Virus (RTSV).
Tungro.treatment: There is no direct chemical cure for the virus. Control the vector (green leafhopper) using insecticides like Imidacloprid.
Tungro.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Synchronize planting in the community. Remove infected plants (roguing) immediately.
